push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.5 (above average MID)
push.body:
A 7.5, BellyTb1. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

DID WELL
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters, your 4th straight match scoring. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. That's leadership you can't fake.
+ 15 completed passes added +0.2 to your rating. Little things add up.
+ 1 tackle won: +0.2. Like finding a twenty in last winter's coat.
+ We beat MidwayMonsters 2-0. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- Rating came in 0.6 below what your on-ball stats earned. Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press.
- You and PhogsToffees were both flagged for finishing. Fix it as a pair: square it when the keeper commits.
- 0.6 under your average. Every player has those. The great ones answer back.
- 3 misplaced passes cost 0.1. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.

Training-ground special: Finesse it to the far post from an angle. One-on-one, go low and hard.

Every great player has nights like this. Most of 'em just don't get a note from me. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.0 (below average MID)
push.body:
A 7.0 against MidwayMonsters, tuxedo_slide. Little below the line for a midfielder, but there's good stuff in here to work with.

DID WELL
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 1 key pass kicked in +0.1. Small hinges swing big doors.
+ Beat MidwayMonsters 2-0. That's a W you were part of, and W's are contagious.

WORK ON
- 29% passing (4 of 14, down from your usual 56%). Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
- Only 14 passes (down from your usual 18). Tell you what: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
- Won 0 of 4 tackles. Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
- Funny thing: PhogsToffees wrestled with passing accuracy too. Two heads, one fix: give each other short options.
- 1.3 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.

Coach's drill: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
